SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.MONITORTMPLNAME, C.MONITORTMPLGROUP, D.TESTID, ES.TESTNAME, E.METHODNAME, F.MONITORPOINTCATEGORYID, G.MONITORPOINTTYPE AS TEMPLATEID, H.TEMPLATENAME FROM T_EMC_MONITOR_POINT_SCHEME A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL B ON A.MONITORTMPLID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL_GROUP C ON C.ID = A.MONITORTMPLGROUPID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD D ON D.ID = A.TESTMETHODID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST ES ON D.TESTID = ES.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD E ON E.ID = A.METHODID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_POINT F ON F.ID = A.MONITORPOINTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_POINT_CATEGORY G ON G.ID = F.MONITORPOINTCATEGORYID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROPERTY_TMPL H ON H.ID = G.MONITORPOINTTYPE) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
